- `prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq` (for multiplicative)

### What's in Mathlib

```lean
-- The core inversion theorem
theorem sum_eq_iff_sum_mul_moebius_eq [AddCommGroup R] [Module R R]
    (f g : ℕ → R) : 
    (∀ n, g n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, f d) ↔ 
    (∀ n, f n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, μ d • g (n/d))
```
